title: HackerEarth: Seven-Segment Display Maximum Number
description: Alice got a number on a 7-segment display. Each digit consumes: 0:6, 1:2, 2:5, 3:5, 4:4, 5:5, 6:6, 7:3, 8:7, 9:6 matchsticks. Given total matchsticks `n`, output the maximum number as a string she can create using ALL matchsticks.
explanation: Greedy choice: '1' uses only 2 matchsticks maximizing number of digits. If odd, leading '7' uses 3 matchsticks.
